commands.localweather.none: No storm cells in this dimension
localweather.configuration.title: Local Weather
localweather.configuration.farClouds.too: Draw clouds further than Better Clouds allows, with less detail far away.
localweather.configuration.cloudDistance: How far clouds are drawn, in blocks. Higher costs generation and GPU time.
localweather.configuration.detailDistanc: Beyond this, every 2nd cloud is drawn twice as big; beyond twice this, every 4th at four times the size.
localweather.configuration.stormTowers.t: Thunderstorms build tall towers of cloud with a flat anvil on top.
localweather.configuration.stormDarkness: Clouds inside storms are darker, so storms stand out from far away.
localweather.configuration.thickRainClou: Rain makes the cloud layer thicker, lumpier underneath and hang a little lower.
localweather.configuration.highLayer.too: A second, flat cloud layer high above the normal clouds. It gets denser near storms.
localweather.configuration.highLayerHeig: How far above the normal clouds the high layer floats, in blocks.
localweather.configuration.cloudCover.to: How cloudy fair weather is, used when the world's weather regions are off (with them the regions decide). Better Clouds' own value is 0.5.
localweather.configuration.preset.toolti: Resets every setting to its default and applies the preset's own changes. Afterwards each setting can still be tweaked. Custom never changes anything.
localweather.configuration.clouds.toolti: The cloud layer. Needs Better Clouds.
localweather.configuration.cloudHeightOf: Moves clouds up or down from the dimension's cloud height (192 in the overworld). +160 suits Tectonic. In the world config this is the cloud height everyone sees.
localweather.configuration.towerHeight.t: Height of the tallest thunderstorm towers above the cloud layer, in blocks. The anvil sits on top.
localweather.configuration.darknessStren: How dark storm clouds get, from 0 (not at all) to 1 (full).
localweather.configuration.skyGloom.tool: How much the sky and fog grey over as a storm's clouds build up, 0 to 1.
localweather.configuration.globalRainTin: Share of Better Clouds' own darkening of every cloud by the rain where you stand. 1 is Better Clouds' behaviour.
localweather.configuration.maxStormsNear: No new storms form near a player while this many are already within about 9 km.
localweather.configuration.stormFrequenc: How often new storms try to form. 1 is about every 2.5 minutes per player.
Share of new storms that are short showers.
localweather.configuration.thunderstormC: Share of new storms that are thunderstorms (warm biomes only). The rest are rain fronts.
localweather.configuration.wind.tooltip: The wind wanders between these speeds and carries every storm and cloud.
localweather.configuration.noRainAboveCl: No rain, rain sound or storm darkness while you are above the cloud base. Only affects what you see and hear.
localweather.configuration.rainShafts.to: Dark veils of rain hang under storms further away, so you can see where it rains hard.
localweather.configuration.rainShaftDist: How far away rain shafts and haze are drawn, in blocks (never further than the clouds).
localweather.configuration.rainHaze.tool: Grey air below the clouds wherever it rains, thicker in heavy rain and thunder. 0 turns it off, 1 is normal, 2 is thick.
localweather.configuration.rainFog.toolt: Fog closes in around you while you stand in rain, more in heavy rain. 0 turns it off, 1 is thickest.
localweather.configuration.followServerC: Use the world's cloud height when playing with Local Weather on the server, so clouds sit where the world's rain stops.
localweather.configuration.dryAboveCloud: Above the cloud base it doesn't rain: players stay dry, snow doesn't pile up, cauldrons don't fill, no lightning.
localweather.configuration.cloudResoluti: Resolution clouds are drawn at, as a share of the screen's. 0.75 is hard to tell apart from 1 and saves a lot of GPU time; 0.5 even more.
AUTO: clouds just above the world's real mountains, measured once per dimension (/localweather cloudheight recompute to redo). VANILLA: 192. TECTONIC: +160. TALL_TERRAIN: +320. CUSTOM: uses Cloud height offset as it is.
localweather.configuration.weatherPreset: Fills in the storm and wind settings when changed. DEFAULT, CALM, STORMY, or HUGE_STORMS for very far views.
localweather.configuration.lightningFlas: Lightning lights up the storm clouds around it, and thunderstorms flash inside their clouds now and then.
localweather.configuration.distantThunde: Thunder rumbles after flashes in far storms, from their direction, later and quieter the further away they are.
localweather.configuration.weatherRegion: Between the storms the sky varies from clear to overcast in areas several km wide that drift with the wind and change over a day or two.
localweather.configuration.skyBalance.to: How cloudy the world is between storms. Balanced: about a third clear, a third fair, a third cloudy.
localweather.configuration.stormsFollowW: Storms form mostly where the sky is cloudy, rarely under clear skies.
Wet biomes cloudier and stormier, dry ones clearer with fewer storms. Affects where storms form.
localweather.configuration.overcastSky.t: Under overcast weather regions the sky greys over and daylight dims a little.
localweather.configuration.cloudsHideSky: Thick cloud hides the sun, moon and stars; clear skies show them fully.
localweather.configuration.cumulusClouds: Now and then a big white cumulus heap builds up in clear to fair weather, grows and falls apart again over about half a day.
localweather.configuration.lightningBolt: Lightning is drawn as Local Weather's jagged, branching bolts (real strikes and some of the flashes in far storms). Off: vanilla's bolt, and none in far storms.
localweather.configuration.rainShaftStre: How dense the rain shafts look, 0.2 (faint) to 2 (heavy).
